messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered — spike in 5xxs and control-plane timeouts for Private deployments in azure-francecentral. Initial metrics point to packet loss on ExpressRoute and repeated BGP neighbor resets. thread_ts: 1935123456
Alex (oncall): Taking this incident. Creating bridge and paging net/team infra. Assigning myself to triage. @Jamie @Maya can you join?
Jamie (net-sre): On it. I see frequent BGP session resets on our edge: `Mar 22 08:12:31 bgp[2456]: BGP neighbor 10.200.1.1 reset, hold timer expired` roughly every 20–40s. Looks like peer PE instability.
Maya (infra-sre): Confirmed control-plane 502/504 spikes. TCP retransmits between our vnet gw and provider are high. MTR shows consistent loss between our vnet-gw and provider-pe.
Alex (oncall): Scope — are only ExpressRoute circuits impacted or any VPN customers too?
Jamie (net-sre): Primarily ExpressRoute, but two site-to-site VPNs that peer through same provider POP show intermittent packet loss. Might be PE-side issues affecting multiple customer circuits.
Lina (customer-success): I'm prepping customer comms. Which Private clusters are hit? Need cluster list to triage customers.
Maya (infra-sre): Affected clusters: private-prod-fr-01, private-staging-fr-02, and a handful of dedicated pools attached to francecentral ER circuits. Metrics snapshot:
```
control-plane 5xx rate: baseline 0.4% -> current 11.2%
p95 control-plane latency: 110ms -> 900ms
ER circuit ER-8821 loss: 0% -> 14%
BGP resets: 28 in last 15m
```
Jamie (net-sre): I've raised a provider ticket (SP case 998877). Provider's initial reply: "Investigating PE fabric instability in France Central POP, possible control-plane thrash; deploying rollback to stable microcode and monitoring." Pushing for priority escalation.
Alex (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Put impacted Private clusters into degraded mode and enable cross-region fallback (prefer northeurope). 2) Apply routing overrides to shift control/data plane to northeurope endpoints. 3) Collect pcaps and BGP debug and share with provider. 4) Notify customers and offer manual failover assistance.
Maya (infra-sre): Applying temporary routing override now. Command to run on internal control-plane API:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://console.internal.redwood/api/v1/routing/overrides \
  -d '{"service":"private-prod-fr-01","preferred_region":"northeurope","ttl":"15m","reason":"azure-francecentral-pe-instability"}'
```
Alex (oncall): Execute and confirm traffic shift. Monitor connection churn and token usage. I'll draft customer note.
Jamie (net-sre): Grabbing BGP debug from our edge now:
```
show bgp neighbors 10.200.1.1 detail
show logging | tail 500 | grep -i bgp
tcpdump -i eth1 host 10.200.1.1 -w /var/tmp/er-peer-fr.pcap
```
I'll upload pcaps to the SP case and to the Azure support ticket.
azure-support-bot: Azure Service Health: Investigating — "Partial network disruption impacting ExpressRoute and VPN customers in France Central. Engineering teams are working on PE node instability." https://status.azure.com/incident/FRANCECENTRAL-20250322
Lina (customer-success): Draft ready: "We are currently experiencing degraded private connectivity in France Central affecting control-plane and some data-plane flows. We are failing over affected clusters to North Europe and coordinating with Azure. Expected customer-visible reconnections during failover. We'll send an update in 30 minutes." Include runbook note: customers may need to rebind sockets; we'll assist.
Maya (infra-sre): Routing override applied for private-prod-fr-01 and private-staging-fr-02. Initial signals show traffic draining to northeurope and p95 control-plane latency improving from 900ms down to ~250ms within 5 minutes for private-prod-fr-01.
Jamie (net-sre): PCAPs and BGP logs uploaded to SP case and Azure ticket 123456789. Provider reports microcode rollback completed — BGP resets down to 3 in last 10m (was 28).
Lina (customer-success): Sending initial customer notification now. Will post updates at +30m and +60m. Major customers notified directly via phone.
Alex (oncall): Good. I'll remain on call for handoff. If stable for 45m we'll begin RCA prep. @Maya @Jamie keep posting updates here.
Maya (infra-sre): Note — a single dedicated customer with an IPsec CE reported persistent loss after our failover. Investigating CE-local issues and will escalate if needed. CC @Lina.
Jamie (net-sre): Minor residual loss on ER-8821 but overall much improved; keeping monitoring thresholds up.
azure-support-bot: Update — "Mitigations deployed to PE nodes; monitoring shows reduced packet loss. Engineers continuing root cause analysis; some residual loss may persist while fabric stabilizes."
Alex (oncall): Handoff to night oncall @Sam in 1h. If BGP resets exceed 10 within any 15m window, escalate to SRE lead oncall.
Sam (night-oncall): Acknowledged. I'll monitor dashboards and step in if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
Lina (customer-success): Most customers acknowledged and appreciate the proactive failover. One enterprise customer requested a network-level postmortem and exact timeline — adding to RCA backlog.
Alex (oncall): Current status: mitigated — traffic rerouted, provider applied fix, monitoring. Next steps: assemble logs/pcaps for RCA, coordinate timeline with Azure SP, and prepare customer-facing postmortem. Closing pager but leaving thread open for monitoring.
incident-bot: Pager resolved at 1935123640 — incident moved to monitoring. Please produce RCA in #postmortems and tag all impacted accounts.
